sentinel-collector status --audit
POLICY: FAIL-CLOSED

TIER 1: STAYS INSIDE CUSTOMER ENVIRONMENT

  • ✔ Raw OS Metrics (psutil 5s scrapes)
  • ✔ Customer Application Logs & SQL Statements
  • ✔ Passwords, Bearer Tokens, API Keys
  • ✔ Internal IP Addresses & Email IDs (REDACTED)
  • ✔ Raw Isolation Forest High-Dim Matrices

TIER 2: APPROVED SAAS EGRESS ONLY

  • ✔ 60s Statistical Summaries (p50/p95/p99)
  • ✔ Host Health Indicators (Percentages only)
  • ✔ ML Anomaly Scores & Severity Signals
  • ✔ Microservice Response Times
  • ✔ HMAC-SHA256 Signed Metadata Payloads

Fail-Closed Privacy Engine

If an export field is not explicitly on the allowlist schema, it is rejected. The collector constructs brand new objects rather than trusting redaction alone.

Distributed AIOps Intelligence

Local Isolation Forest detects anomalies on the host. Centralized SaaS runs correlation-based Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and trend exhaustion forecasting.

Zero Inbound Ports

Collectors run inside strict VPCs without exposing public ingress. Outbound metadata is transmitted over HTTPS with HMAC-SHA256 integrity verification.

SentinelOps Observability Platform. Built with Next.js, FastAPI & Scikit-Learn.
